# Dominica News

> Dominica News (DominicaNews.DM) — independent online newsroom covering breaking news, politics, business, sports, and culture in the Commonwealth of Dominica and the wider Caribbean.

Dominica News publishes daily reporting, live coverage of major events, and in-depth features. Content is in English and produced by local reporters and editors.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest stories, breaking news, and featured Dominica coverage.
- [Search](/search): Search articles by keyword.
- [Live Updates](/live): Live blog coverage of breaking and ongoing events.
- [About](/page/about): About Dominica News.
- [Contact](/page/contact): Contact the newsroom.

## Feeds

- [RSS Feed](/rss.xml): Latest 50 articles in RSS 2.0.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap.
- [Google News Sitemap](/news-sitemap.xml): News sitemap (last 7 days).

## Optional

- [Article URLs](/news/): Individual article pages live under `/news/{slug}`.
- [Live coverage URLs](/live/): Live blog pages live under `/live/{slug}`.
